data.content: {"story":{"as_a":"task owner","i_want":"to update the details of an existing task","so_that":"my task information stays accurate and current","business_description":"Users can change the details of a task after it has been created. Each task keeps a Last Updated Date that reflects the most recent update. Updates must keep the task title non-empty and the Due Date not earlier than the Creation Date. The frontend shows a success or error message after each update and shows success only after the backend confirms the change.","business_value":"Users keep task records accurate over time, so the task list and task report reflect current work.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"an existing task with a non-empty title","when":"the user changes the title to another non-empty value and saves","then":"the backend confirms the update, the task shows the new title, and the Last Updated Date is set to the time of the save"},{"given":"an existing task","when":"the user clears the title field and saves","then":"the task is not saved, the backend returns a validation error for the missing title, and the frontend shows an error message and keeps the previous title"},{"given":"an existing task with Creation Date 2024-03-01 and Due Date 2024-03-10","when":"the user sets the Due Date to 2024-02-28 and saves","then":"the update is rejected with a validation error, the frontend shows an error message, and the stored Due Date remains 2024-03-10"},{"given":"an existing task","when":"the user saves a valid update and the backend confirms it","then":"the frontend shows a success message and the Last Updated Date is changed"},{"given":"an existing task","when":"the user saves an update and the backend returns an error or cannot be reached","then":"the frontend shows an error message, does not show a success message, and does not display the unsaved changes as saved"},{"given":"a task ID that does not exist","when":"a client sends an update request for that ID","then":"the backend returns a simple not-found error and stores nothing"}],"edge_cases":["Title containing only whitespace: the PRD says the title must be non-empty but does not state whether whitespace-only titles are allowed; this is an open question.","Due Date equal to Creation Date: the PRD says Due Date must not be earlier than Creation Date, so equal dates are allowed.","Updating a task that was deleted by another user: the backend returns a not-found error for the update.","Update request with a Due Date but no change to other fields: the PRD does not state whether Last Updated Date changes when nothing changed; this is an open question.","Whether the Creation Date itself can be updated is not stated in the PRD; this is an open question.","Concurrent updates to the same task: the PRD does not define conflict handling; this is an open question.","The exact field list that is editable on update is not enumerated in the PRD beyond title and Due Date; this is an open question."],"dependencies":["US-create-and-view-tasks"],"definition_of_done":["Backend update endpoint for a task by ID is implemented and returns the updated task on success","Backend rejects an empty or missing title with a simple validation error","Backend rejects a Due Date earlier than the Creation Date with a simple validation error","Backend returns a simple not-found error for a non-existent task ID","Last Updated Date is set by the backend on each successful update","Frontend shows a success message only after the backend confirms the update","Frontend shows an error message on any backend failure and does not show a successful state","Automated tests cover valid update, empty title, Due Date before Creation Date, and not-found cases","Open questions about whitespace-only titles, no-change updates, and editable fields are documented and resolved with the product owner"]},"tasks":[{"key_slug":"task-update-endpoint","title":"[BE] Add PUT /tasks/{id} endpoint to update task details","track":"backend","area":"backend","description":"Add an endpoint that updates an existing task by ID. Validate that the title is non-empty and that Due Date is not earlier than Creation Date. Set Last Updated Date on each successful update. Return a simple not-found error for unknown IDs and simple errors for invalid input.","size":"M","consumes_api":false,"touches_db":true,"requirement_ids":["R-bc3213df","R-03df7815","R-efe1e5d4","R-244669c0","R-9dc414dc"],"derived_reason":null,"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Endpoint accepts updated task fields and returns the updated task on success","Empty or missing title returns a simple validation error and stores nothing","Due Date earlier than Creation Date returns a simple validation error and stores nothing","Unknown task ID returns a simple not-found error","Last Updated Date is set on each successful update","Internal or database errors return a simple error response"]},{"key_slug":"task-last-updated-field","title":"[BE] Add Last Updated Date column to the task model","track":"backend","area":"db","description":"Add the Last Updated Date field to the task data model and its storage, with a migration for existing tasks.","size":"S","consumes_api":false,"touches_db":true,"requirement_ids":["R-31569dba"],"derived_reason":null,"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Task model includes a Last Updated Date field","Migration adds the column to existing task records","Existing tasks have a defined Last Updated Date value after migration"]},{"key_slug":"task-edit-form","title":"[FE] Add edit task form with title and Due Date fields","track":"frontend","area":"frontend","description":"Provide an edit form for an existing task that shows the current title and Due Date and submits changes to the update endpoint. The form must not show a saved state until the backend confirms the update.","size":"M","consumes_api":true,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":["R-bc3213df","R-ab9e9cb0"],"derived_reason":null,"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Form loads the current task values","Submit calls the update endpoint and waits for the response","Form does not display success before a successful backend response","Backend errors are shown to the user without changing the displayed saved values"]},{"key_slug":"task-update-messages","title":"[FE] Show success and error messages after task update","track":"frontend","area":"frontend","description":"Display a success message after a confirmed update and an error message when the update fails, including validation and not-found errors.","size":"S","consumes_api":true,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":["R-d57336f7","R-ab9e9cb0"],"derived_reason":null,"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Success message is shown only after backend confirmation","Error message is shown for validation, not-found, and server errors","No success message appears on failure"]},{"key_slug":"task-update-test-suite","title":"[QA] Test suite for updating task details","track":"qa_general","area":"qa","description":"Automated tests covering the update endpoint, validation rules, Last Updated Date behaviour, and frontend messages.","size":"M","consumes_api":true,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":[],"derived_reason":"testing","is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Tests cover valid update, empty title, Due Date before Creation Date, and not-found cases","Tests verify Last Updated Date changes on successful update","Tests verify no success message is shown on backend failure"]}]}
